name: cc-skin-pro
description: A complete Claude Code setup in one marketplace: the dsh-TUI start page, skins and UI polish, and the plugins around them — file tree, model picker, context meter, prompt queue, bookmarks, test results, smart compaction and a mod store.

plugins.name: cc-band-pro
plugins.description: cc-skin-pro's powerline bar alone, locked to Catppuccin Mocha: thinking, model, diff, tree, marks and usage, each block opening its own plugin's pane at once, mid-turn, with no line left in the conversation.

plugins.name: find-model
plugins.description: A sidebar model picker: the same list as /model, with search and an effort row.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files.

plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: A live /ctx pane: the context window by category, usage limits with pace, tool calls and model requests.

plugins.name: after
plugins.description: A real prompt queue for Claude Code: /after <task> runs it after the current task, without steering; reorder and edit the queue on a band or in a side pane. A local fork, maintained here.

plugins.name: transcript-bookmarks
plugins.description: Bookmark transcript messages or selected text and jump back to them from a side pane. A local fork: the pane renders each bookmark with skins' markdown renderer; requires skins, and falls back to plain text when the skin is off.

plugins.name: cc-dsh-like
plugins.description: A dsh-TUI style start page for Claude Code: the Claude-girl portrait with the CLAUDE/CODE dot-matrix wordmark, and she reacts when you click her.

plugins.name: sidebar-clear
plugins.description: Paints plugin sidebars with no background of their own, so your terminal's background and its opacity show through instead of the theme's solid gray.

plugins.name: paste-preview
plugins.description: Local fork of paste-preview 0.2.0: previews pasted images above the prompt and appends thumbnails under sent messages; the editor opens only when you click Edit.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for Claude Code: tool rows with icons, diff, table and Mermaid chart cards, a usage band and fifteen themes. /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: redgreen
plugins.description: Test results in a pane: failures from Claude's vitest, jest, pytest, cargo, go, bun and deno runs, their detail and run history.

plugins.name: smart-compact
plugins.description: Compacts at the right moment: after a commit or green tests, before the prompt cache expires, or when Claude asks for it.

plugins.name: mod-store
plugins.description: An app store for Claude Code mods in a pane: /mods to browse, search and install 2,700 community mods, with what each can access shown before you install.
